answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. A new identity locks 80 credits for 15 epochs and records a fingerprint of timing and style, kept as a relic sample. Each epoch a check compares new work with it across a meadow of tasks; a clone diverges like leaves in a gale, unable to copy timing. Failure burns 20 credits. Forging 100 identities locks 8,000 credits, while an honest agent pays one 80-credit lock and earns undiluted rewards.
